g.text: Daily alarm summary - new session (Pending implementation)
Record failure and release own slot
Recheck state, time, claim and capacity
and Run link in one transaction
CAS READY to STARTING for live owner
Persist events and root terminal state
Update summary and release own slot
Acceptance rejection records failure without starting.
Duplicate acceptance returns the existing link only.
Candidate: pause or delete after acceptance does not cancel the Run.
Lost owner requires reconciliation, not replay.
